svg.title: Wiring on the real boards: ESP32-S2 mini, CC1101 and DHT22
svg.text: All logic is 3.3 V. The CC1101 must never get 5 V.
GPIO 6 → DHT22 VCC (it powers the sensor)
Pin numbers of the CC1101 are the numbers printed on the module (1, 2 at one end of the header, 7, 8 at the other). Check the labels on your own module and board before you power it.
